description: Defines data structures, classes, and interfaces related to MAC layer cell results, scheduling, and SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) parameters in a 5G NR (New Radio) implementation.

classes.name: mac_cell_result_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying MAC cell results, including downlink and uplink scheduling results and completion notifications.

classes.name: mac_result_notifier
classes.description: Interface for retrieving cell-specific result notifiers based on cell index.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Notify about new downlink scheduling results.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_data
methods.description: Notify about new downlink data PDUs.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Notify about new uplink scheduling results.

methods.name: on_cell_results_completion
methods.description: Notify that all results for a specific slot and cell are complete.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Retrieve the cell-specific result notifier for a given cell index.
